label_en: Sports hall (school idrottssal to full-size idrottshall)
summary: Indoor hall for school PE (idrott och hälsa) and club sport (handball, floorball, basketball, volleyball, badminton). No law sets hall dimensions: they come from the sports federations' court sizes (collected in SKR's 'Måttboken') and municipal programmes. Uppsala's 2023 standard programme for a full-size hall sets 43 x 23 m clear floor, 40 x 20 m courts, 7 m clear height without installations, 4 changing rooms for 20 persons each, a flexible single changing room, stands for 100 seated and a maximum of 299 persons, with a typical BTA of at least 1,700 m2. A school-PE hall (idrottssal) is 250–350 m2 of floor (Uppsala UBF, 2017). This is usually a POOR FIT in office buildings: the 7 m clear height and roughly 23 m column-free span are incompatible with office storey heights (about 3.3–3.9 m floor to floor) and 6–8 m column grids. A hall can normally only go into an existing building by removing slabs and columns (major structural intervention) or in an attached new-build volume.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: 2A (max 150 persons) or 2B (more than 150). BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11–12 §§ name 'sporthallar' explicitly. Events with spectators beyond 1,200 people go to Vk 0 (2 kap. 9 §). See cross_cutting.json fire_vk_0 and fire_vk_2abc.

key_laws.ref: BFS 2024:6 4 kap. 10 § tabell 4:1 (C4 4.0 kN/m2, C5 5.0 kN/m2 for stands), 13 § dynamic forces
BFS 2024:10 buller: 2 kap. 9 § (lokaler, functional; includes reverberation time)
AFS 2023:12 (PE teachers' workplace): 3 kap. 46–54 §§ changing and showers

permits: Bygglov for change of use, and in practice for the structural change (removal of slabs) or a new extension (PBL 9 kap. 2 §). Detaljplan must allow sports or school use; a full-size hall is often planned as its own building.
Matches and events with an audience may need a Police permit for offentlig tillställning (Ordningslagen 1993:1617 2 kap.; not re-checked).
regulatory.operator_oversight: Municipality (kultur- och fritidsförvaltning for bookings; utbildningsförvaltning for school PE); Skolinspektionen indirectly (PE teaching); räddningstjänst

gross_m2_per_unit.source: Uppsala kommun, Funktionsprogram för stor idrottshall, 2023-04-17 (IFN-2022-00104), p. 4: 'Dagens idrottshallar har i regel en BTA om minst 1700 kvm'. Full-size hall with 43 x 23 m clear floor (p. 13).
gross_m2_per_unit.note: School-size hall (idrottssal): 250–350 m2 floor area per Uppsala utbildningsförvaltning, cited in Behovsprogram för idrottslokaler vid Johannesbäckskolan, 2017-10-26, p. 2. Gross area for the school-size variant is not given.

staff_per_unit.source: Teachers per class; hall staff minimal. Uppsala: teacher room for 2–6 teachers (p. 12).

egress_design_density.source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 §: maximum expected number. The Uppsala programme sets 'Maximal personbelastning 299 personer' for a 43 x 23 m hall (p. 13). For use as a samlingssal, the programme notes that ventilation and fire design must allow it (p. 14). The 2.5 p/m2 samlingslokal default applies if the hall is used for events without a defined maximum.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Modelling assumption (indicative, not sourced). School PE on weekdays 8–15 (a hall is booked by the class, so presence is a class of 25–30), and club sport 17–22 at near-full booking. Weekends have tournaments and matches. Capacity is a booking slot rather than a person count.

required.basis: Defining space. Dimensions come from sports federations via SKR Måttboken and municipal programmes, not law.

size.count: 1 hall. 43 x 23 m clear floor = 989 m2 (full-size); 250–350 m2 for a school idrottssal; Nacka programmes use 43–44 x 23–24 m
size.source: Uppsala Funktionsprogram för stor idrottshall 2023, p. 13: 'Storlek 43*23 meter fritt golvmått', 'Fri takhöjd utan installationer 7 meter', 'Fria spelmått 40*20 meter', 'Belysning minst 750 lux enligt måttboken', 'Ridåvägg med gångdörr', 'Maximal personbelastning 299 personer'. School size: Uppsala Johannesbäckskolan behovsprogram 2017, p. 2. The upper range of 1,056 m2 (44 x 24 m) comes from Nacka (search summary, not opened).

spaces.shareable_note: School by day, clubs by evening; also school assemblies and graduations (Uppsala p. 14). Event use must be covered by ventilation and fire design.
spaces.notes: The 7 m clear height is a programme value (Uppsala, Nacka) tied to federation requirements for ball sports. It is not a law; smaller existing halls with 6 m height exist. Column-free span about 23 m. Floor C4 4.0 kN/m2 with dynamic effects (BFS 2024:6). Sprung sports floor. Divider curtain: Uppsala requires a sound reduction of at least 30 dB (p. 15). Wall reflectance under 70 % at window walls and under 60 % elsewhere, with limited daylight to avoid glare (p. 14). Reverberation: BFS 2024:10 2 kap. 9 § functional. Lighting: at least 750 lux per Måttboken (Uppsala p. 13).

required.basis: Uppsala 2023 pp. 10–11: four changing rooms, 20 persons each, with shower rooms of at least 4 showers (1 accessible) designed for privacy. For staff, AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 46–54 §§ (law).

size.count: 4 rooms x 20 persons (Uppsala 2023, full-size hall); Johannesbäck 2017: 4 rooms with 22 seats each and 6 showers per double changing room
size.source: Uppsala programmes give counts, not m2.

spaces.shareable_note: Can be shared with a gym or outdoor pitches (Johannesbäck adds changing rooms with an entrance towards the football pitch).
spaces.notes: Uppsala: an accessible WC in every other changing room, equipped for showering (p. 11); Johannesbäck: an accessible WC in every changing room. Threshold-free doors, possibility of forced ventilation, wall-hung benches.

spaces.label_en: Flexible single changing room / referee room

required.basis: Uppsala 2023 pp. 12–13: one room for 4 persons with its own entrance, lockable, one shower; for individual changing, referees and as a meeting room.
Uppsala 2023 pp. 11–12: one general store reachable from both half-halls, two school stores (one on each side of the curtain), one outdoor store, one club store; lockable except the general store.

size.source: No m2 in the Uppsala 2023 programme. Johannesbäck 2017 lists 'Förråd 10 kvm' (p. 3). A Nacka document proposes 20 m2 and 4 m height for large equipment (search summary, not opened).

spaces.notes: Stores must open directly onto the hall floor at the same level, with impact protection (Uppsala p. 11–12).

required.basis: Uppsala 2023 p. 14: stand for 100 seated, wheelchair places at floor level, free sightlines; also used for assemblies and lessons.

size.source: No m2 per seat in source.

spaces.notes: Stand loads: C5 5.0 kN/m2 (BFS 2024:6 tabell 4:1). BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 6 § allows not all audience places to be accessible.

spaces.label_en: PE teachers' room with changing and shower

required.basis: Teachers' workplace: AFS 2023:12 (cross_cutting.json staff_facilities). Uppsala 2023 p. 12: workplace for 2–6 teachers, changing and shower, daylight, lockable cupboards so clubs can use the room in the evening.

spaces.shareable_note: Club leaders' room in the evening (Uppsala).

spaces.label_en: Entrance, public WC/RWC, cleaning rooms, kiosk/pentry, waste room
spaces.label_sv: Entré, publik WC/RWC, städförråd, pentry/kiosk, avfallsrum

required.basis: Uppsala 2023 pp. 9–13, 18: one public RWC and one WC by the entrance; a large cleaning room plus a separate small one for clubs; a pentry with lockable serving hatch; waste room. Accessible public WC is law if public WCs exist (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 7 §).

spaces.shareable_note: Johannesbäck 2017: for evening club use there should be no more than one entrance (supervision).

variants.label: School idrottssal (250–350 m2 floor)
variants.changes: Programme value of 250–350 m2 (Uppsala UBF 2017); one class at a time, 2 changing rooms. Height requirement for this size was not found in a source (open question). Still needs a column-free span of about 12–18 m (derived from an 18 x 36 m hall divided in two; indicative).

variants.label: Full-size divisible hall (43 x 23 m, 7 m clear)
variants.changes: Uppsala 2023 programme: BTA at least 1,700 m2, 4+1 changing rooms, stand for 100, max 299 persons, divider curtain of at least 30 dB.

variants.label: Large hall / arena with spectators
variants.changes: More than 150 persons is Vk 2B; above 1,200 is Vk 0 (fire analysis); stands at C5 5.0 kN/m2. Not a realistic conversion target in office stock.

typical_blockers: Clear height: 7 m without installations (Uppsala 2023, Nacka) vs typical office floor-to-floor of about 3.3–3.9 m (indicative). This requires removing one or two slabs, which destroys floor area and needs a new stability system (major structure-layer intervention, poor reversibility).
Column-free span of about 23 m for a full-size hall (20 m court plus run-off) vs office column grids of about 6–8 m (indicative), requiring transfer structures.
Floor load C4 4.0 kN/m2 plus dynamic effects (BFS 2024:6) vs office B 2.5 kN/m2; stands C5 5.0.
Ball impact and impact noise to adjacent uses; reverberation control in a large volume.
Large footprint (BTA of at least 1,700 m2 for full-size) on one level with stores, changing rooms and an entrance.
typical_enablers: Office buildings with a large double-height ground-floor hall, atrium, or a low annex (canteen, garage, warehouse) that can be raised to about 7 m.
Courtyard or adjoining plot for a new-build hall attached to the converted office, which then hosts changing rooms, stores and club rooms (these fit office floors well).
Smaller activity rooms (dance, gymnastics, martial arts) fit office floors with about 3 m clear height better; see gym_fitness.gym_group_studio and culture_makerspace.

sources.ref: Uppsala kommun, Funktionsprogram för stor idrottshall, Kommunledningskontoret, 2023-04-17, IFN-2022-00104, pp. 4, 9–15, 18
Uppsala kommun, Behovsprogram för idrottslokaler vid Johannesbäckskolan, 2017-10-26, pp. 2–3
SKR Måttboken (court dimensions and lines; referenced by Uppsala p. 14; not opened)
Nacka kommun handlingar on Stavsborgskolan and Ektorps skola halls (search summaries only, not opened)

open_questions: Riksidrottsförbundet and SKR Måttboken were not opened. Verify the 7 m height and the 40 x 20 m court against Måttboken and the federation rules (handball, floorball, volleyball).
Clear height for a school-size idrottssal (250–350 m2) was not found in a source.
Changing-room m2 per person is not stated in the Uppsala programmes; a municipal room-data sheet (rumsfunktionsprogram) may have it.
Office floor-to-floor and grid figures are indicative ranges (not sourced) and should be replaced by the pilot building's actual data.
Why the Uppsala programme sets 299 persons (keeps below a threshold?) is not explained in the text.
